home.documentDescription: KrishiLens is your AI-powered crop investigation assistant.
home.eyebrow: Made for the people who grow our food
home.headline: Smarter Crop Care Starts Here.
home.subtitle: Investigate crop problems with AI-powered visual analysis, follow-up questions, and ongoing monitoring.
home.illustration: Illustration of a crop field with healthy green plants
home.rooted: Designed with local needs in mind
home.builtFor: Practical support for your next crop-care decision.
home.stepsIntro: A simple process to organize what you see and decide what to check next.

steps.photoText: Choose a clear image or take a photo on your phone.
steps.investigateText: Review visual observations, answer follow-up questions, and explore evidence.
steps.trackText: Save a case and compare later observations with the same plant area.

home.featuresIntro: KrishiLens helps organize visual observations and guidance. It does not provide confirmed agricultural diagnoses.

features.segmentationText: Highlights candidate regions in an image when a validated overlay is available.
features.investigationText: An AI-guided investigation asks follow-up questions when more context is useful.
features.bilingualText: Use the interface in Bangla or English, with your language preference remembered.
features.evidenceText: Review retrieved sources, visible observations, and uncertainty in the report.
features.historyText: Keep scans together and revisit the same crop case over time.

home.ctaTitle: Start with what you can see.
home.ctaText: Upload a crop photo to begin a visual investigation.
home.intro: Share your observations to get cautious, AI-generated guidance. No image is analyzed, and this is not a confirmed diagnosis.
home.example: For example: Brown spots have appeared on my rice leaves

imageAnalysis.title: Segment a crop image
imageAnalysis.intro: Upload or capture a crop image. SAM 3.1 will separately look for the crop leaf and the selected visual region. Candidate discoloration is not necessarily crop damage or disease.
imageAnalysis.dropImage: Drop the image to select it
imageAnalysis.fileRules: JPEG, PNG, or WebP · Up to 4 MB · Single image only
imageAnalysis.noPercent: No percentage is shown because the masks were absent or could not be validated.
imageAnalysis.warning: The segmentation service returned an observation that needs attention.
imageAnalysis.responseSizeNotice: The overlay was omitted because the analysis response exceeded the hosting size limit. Measurements and scan access are unchanged.
imageAnalysis.caution: Segmentation highlights visual regions only. It does not diagnose a disease or establish scientifically validated crop severity. Confirm observations with a qualified agricultural officer.
imageAnalysis.overlayUnavailable: A segmentation overlay is not available for this image.
imageAnalysis.describeInstead: Want to describe what you’ve seen instead?

investigation.title: Investigate your observations
investigation.intro: The agent uses actual scan observations and retrieved references, asks a follow-up when useful, and makes uncertainty clear.
investigation.askTitle: What would you like to investigate?
investigation.moreInfo: A little more information is needed
investigation.disclaimer: This is an investigation aid, not a confirmed diagnosis.
investigation.translateFailed: The report could not be translated. The original report is still available.
investigation.translationNote: Translated text is provided for readability. Original observations, measurements, and citations are unchanged.
investigation.noReportTranslation: Only report text is translated; the original follow-up question remains in {{language}}.
investigation.sessionLanguageNote: The investigation continues in its original language ({{language}}); this display translation does not change the case language.

questions.answerPlaceholder: Share what you have observed or know
questions.answerPlaceholderBn: যা দেখেছেন বা জানেন তা লিখুন
questions.required: Please enter your observations or answer.

reports.title: Investigation report
reports.subtitle: Your crop investigation
reports.noCauses: Available information does not reliably distinguish possible causes.
reports.measurementAccepted: The segmented candidate region overlaps {{percentage}}% of the leaf mask. This is not disease severity.
reports.measurementMissing: No affected-area estimate is available; this is not interpreted as zero damage.
reports.noSources: No symptom-specific agricultural source was retrieved for this investigation.
reports.escalation: Consult a qualified local agricultural officer: {{reason}}

caseHistory.title: Crop case history
caseHistory.intro: Keep scans, observations, and planned re-checks together on this device.
caseHistory.empty: No saved cases yet. Create a case to keep future crop observations together.
caseHistory.noInvestigations: No saved investigation reports are attached to this case yet.
caseHistory.uploadInstructions: Use a clear photo of the same plant area when possible. JPEG, PNG, or WebP up to 4 MB. SAM observations are visual estimates, not a diagnosis.
caseHistory.observations: What has changed since the last scan?
caseHistory.observationsPlaceholder: Describe visible changes or new symptoms
caseHistory.samePlantRegion: This shows the same plant and leaf area
caseHistory.comparisonLimitations: Image measurements can vary with framing, lighting, and the plant area photographed. A smaller percentage does not prove recovery or treatment success.
caseHistory.noComparisonNote: No earlier scan was available, so this standard note was used.
caseHistory.modelFallback: This note uses a built-in explanation because the AI service was unavailable.
caseHistory.visibleOnly: Visible image observation only; not a diagnosis or proof of plant health.
caseHistory.samePlantQuestion: Confirm how comparable these photos are

errors.INVALID_IMAGE: Choose a valid JPEG, PNG, or WebP image up to 4 MB.
errors.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.ANALYSIS_FAILED: We could not complete the analysis. Please try again.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: This investigation has expired. Please start a new one.
errors.MEASUREMENT_UNAVAILABLE: A reliable affected-area measurement is unavailable.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not connect to KrishiLens. Check that the backend is running and try again.
errors.INVESTIGATION_FAILED: The investigation could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.UPLOAD_FAILED: Image analysis could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.INVALID_REQUEST: Check the information and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: The service is busy right now. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.STORAGE_BUSY: Temporary investigation storage is busy. Please try again later.
errors.SCAN_UNAVAILABLE: This scan is unavailable. Upload and analyze the image again.
errors.ALREADY_PROCESSING: This investigation is already processing a request.
errors.NOT_WAITING: This investigation is not waiting for an answer.
errors.TRANSLATION_FAILED: The report could not be translated. The original report remains available.
errors.CASE_ACCESS_REQUIRED: Create or restore case access on this device to continue.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Case access is missing or expired. Create a new case or restore access on this device.
errors.PREVIOUS_SCAN_NOT_FOUND: The selected earlier scan is unavailable.
errors.PERSISTENCE_FAILED: The re-check could not be saved. Please try again.
errors.LOCAL_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: This browser cannot securely retain case access. Enable local storage and try again.
errors.REQUEST_FAILED: The request could not be completed. Please try again.

validation.imageType: Choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.
validation.imageSize: Images must be 4 MB or smaller.
